grid-01-aceptacion-a: A woman standing at the bottom of a deep earthen pit, seen in cross-section; she has stopped digging and holds a shovel loosely, resting it against the wall, looking up at the bright strip of sky at the rim; loose dirt piled high around the edge.

A woman sitting at a small wooden table in front of an old brass balance scale: on one pan a small grey rain cloud (the feeling she avoided), on the other pan a heap of precious things she gave up (a framed family photo, a potted plant, running shoes, an unopened letter); the cloud side is light, the side of lost things hangs low.

A woman sitting stiffly in a wooden chair, connected by thin wires on her fingertips and a strap around her chest to an old vintage polygraph machine on a desk; the machine's paper strip shows the needles scribbling wild jagged peaks; she grips the armrests forcing herself to look calm.

A tug-of-war across a dark deep chasm: on the left edge the woman, on the right edge a large shaggy smoky dark-grey monster made of soft watercolor washes (big shapeless body, small eyes, clearly a creature, not scary-cartoon); a rope spans the pit between them; the woman has opened her hands and the rope is falling slack from them.

The same woman shown twice side by side on one bench: on the left, arms rigid and fully stretched, straining to push a sheet of handwritten paper away from her face; on the right, the same sheet resting softly on her lap, shoulders relaxed, looking ahead at a window with plants.

Two glasses of water on a wooden table: in the left glass the water is clear with a single smooth stone resting at the bottom; in the right glass a hand stirs violently with a spoon and the same stone has turned the whole water into swirling brown mud.
grid-02-aceptacion-b: A single large old bronze coin spinning on its edge on a wooden table, caught mid-spin so both faces are partly visible at once: one face engraved with a rain cloud and falling drops, the other face engraved with a small heart and sprouting leaves; a woman's hand nearby has just set it spinning.

Close-up of two hands with their index fingers inserted into the two ends of a woven bamboo Chinese finger trap tube; the fingers push gently inward toward each other and the weave in the middle is visibly loosened and widened.

A warm house party seen through an open front door: inside, friends laughing and dancing under warm lamplight; in the doorway the woman stands with her back to the party, arms spread across the door frame, blocking a scruffy, muddy, grumpy stranger in a ragged coat on the porch; she is missing the party behind her.

A woman lying flat on her back with arms and legs spread wide, floating calmly on the surface of a pool of thick brown-grey quicksand in a dry swampy clearing with reeds and dead branches; the quicksand is wrinkled, dense mud, clearly sand and mud, not water, no beach, no sea; a lost boot half sunk nearby.

A woman sitting cross-legged with eyes closed, one hand on her chest; inside her chest a small dark tangled knot of watercolor, surrounded by a wide luminous open space that expands like breath in soft concentric washes around her body.

Cross-section of a stormy grey sea with tall waves and rain: a small wooden rowing boat with the woman inside holding on, a taut anchor rope going down through the green water to an iron anchor hooked firmly into the rocky seabed; the boat stays in place despite the storm.
grid-03-defusion-a: Underwater cross-section: a calm fish swimming freely between several fishing hooks that dangle from lines coming down from the surface; each hook is baited with a small crumpled paper note; the fish passes by without biting.

A woman sitting at a kitchen table speaking toward a white glass of milk and a milk carton; from her mouth flows a string of soft round sound bubbles that gradually lose their shape and dissolve into faint wavy sound lines; only milk, no fruit, no lemon.

Close view of the woman kneeling at the bank of a clear stream, gently placing a large autumn leaf on the water; on the leaf rests a small grey cloud shape; other leaves with little cloud shapes float away downstream.

The same woman shown twice on one park bench: on the left, her open palms pressed against her face covering her eyes, the palms covered with faint ink scribbles; on the right, her hands resting palms-up on her lap, scribbles still visible, now she looks at a sunny park where a child flies a kite.

A woman walking along a tree-lined city sidewalk, turning at a corner by her own choice; beside her at shoulder height floats a small chatty grey cloud-like creature with a tiny mouth (her mind), gesturing and talking nonstop with empty squiggles; she keeps walking calmly.

A woman walking up a winding path toward a sunny hilltop while carrying a small personal rain cloud above her head that walks with her; beside the path lies an old wooden barrier gate, fallen open, no longer blocking the way.
grid-04-defusion-b: A conveyor-belt sushi counter seen from the side: small plates pass on the moving belt, some carrying little dark storm clouds and thorny tangles instead of food; the woman sits at the counter with her chopsticks resting, simply watching the plates go by without taking them.

A cozy room: the woman reads a book in an armchair by a window with a cup of tea; on a shelf in the corner an old vintage radio emits sound waves filled with tiny dark lightning bolts and rain clouds; she keeps reading.

A woman holding an old hardbound book, closing it; a long tangled ribbon of small grey swirling scenes spills from between the pages and is being folded back inside; behind her a bookshelf with a free space waiting for the book; blank spine, no letters.

A woman sitting at a desk writing a letter; on her shoulder perches a small fluffy anxious owl-like creature flapping and squawking warnings; she turns to it with a gentle smile, hand on her heart, as if thanking it, and keeps writing.

An old gramophone on a table: a heavy dark grey storm cloud flows into its horn from one side, and out of the horn come light playful bubbles and loopy ribbons; the woman sits beside listening, amused, head tilted.

A large heavy dark cloud-shaped thought hovering in a field; the woman has taken two steps back from it, her two footprints visible in the grass between her and the cloud; she now stands at a distance observing it calmly with her hands relaxed.
grid-05-presente: A woman sitting on a garden bench, attentive to her senses: one hand touching the bark of a tree, a steaming cup of coffee beside her, a bird singing on a branch, a butterfly she watches, flowers she can smell.
A woman standing barefoot on grass with feet firmly planted, soft roots growing from her soles into the earth, while a stormy wind with swirling leaves blows above her head; she stays steady.
A woman washing dishes at a kitchen sink by a sunny window, fully present: she looks with curiosity at soap bubbles catching the light, warm water running over her hands, steam rising.

A plain cup with a small chip on the rim on a table, an old film camera on a tripod pointing at it; the woman peels off a crumpled dark sticky label full of scribbles that was stuck over the cup, revealing it as it simply is.
A woman standing still on a busy city sidewalk with blurred pedestrians rushing past her; she has paused with eyes closed and one hand on her chest, breathing.

A warm consulting room: two armchairs facing each other, the woman as client and a middle-aged male therapist with glasses talking attentively; a soft glowing thread of light connects them; a plant and a window with a faint city view.
grid-06-yo-contexto: A large wooden chessboard with white and black pieces mid-battle, some knocked over, held up from below on the open palms of the calm woman, who looks at the battle without taking part.
View through an airplane window: below, a dark thunderstorm with lightning; above, a vast clear calm blue sky with soft sunlight; the woman's silhouette in the seat looking out.
A woman walking along a country path holding many strings of balloons that float above her head, some dark grey, some light and muted colored; she looks ahead and chooses the path.

A theater: on stage a narrow bright spotlight falls on a small dark crumpled object, while soft light reveals the whole stage with other props (a plant, a bicycle, a table with a family photo); the woman sits in a velvet seat in the audience, watching the whole stage.

Three versions of the same person standing in a row along a path: a little girl, a teenage girl and the adult woman, all looking at the same distant tree on the horizon; a faint thread of light links them.
Two neighboring mountains: on one, a climber struggles on a steep rock face with a rope; on the neighboring peak a person sits with binoculars watching and can see the route the climber cannot see.
grid-07-valores: Cutaway view of a spacious, solid house: rooms with all kinds of furniture (a broken old armchair, a messy pile of boxes, a beautiful lamp, a piano); the woman stands calmly in the open doorway; the house holds everything.
A woman with a backpack walking along a path holding an open antique compass pointing toward a rising sun in the east; behind her small flags mark milestones she has already passed.
A garden with flower beds: the woman waters a flowering bed with a watering can, leaving a few weeds at the edges untouched; the bed she cares for is lush.
An elderly woman at an outdoor garden table under string lights, family and friends of all ages raising their glasses in a toast to her, a simple cake on the table, warm evening light.

A round wooden target with concentric rings leaning against a tree, divided into four sectors tinted in four different muted colors, a few pins placed nearer or farther from the center; the woman holds a pin, deciding where to place it.
A woman sitting on a porch at sunset holding a cup, eyes half closed, smiling softly; above her a soft watercolor memory bubble shows a sweet moment of laughter with a loved one at the seaside.
grid-08-accion: A woman driving an old bus along a country road toward a blank signpost on the horizon; behind her inside the bus a group of rowdy strange passengers (grumpy shadowy creatures, a gremlin, a ghostly figure) shout and point; she keeps both hands on the wheel.

A fork in a path: the left branch descends into a dark foggy ravine, the right branch climbs toward a sunny meadow with a small house; the woman stands at the fork with a small rain cloud above her head, stepping onto the right branch.
A woman at the foot of a long stone staircase rising toward a mountain top; the first step is very small and low and she is placing her foot on it; the higher steps fade into mist.
A woman at a potter's wheel shaping a clay vase with clay-covered hands, smiling; on a shelf beside her, imperfect uneven pots and one repaired with golden seams.

Close view of an old wooden radio with two large knobs: the left knob, marked with a small storm symbol, is tied with a chain and cannot turn; the woman's hand turns the right knob, marked with a small open-hand symbol.
A woman wading through a muddy swamp with reeds, mud up to her knees, holding a walking stick, looking forward to a beautiful sunlit mountain beyond the swamp.
